ad_info.structure_source: library format F59 (Fondo premium, titular enorme, 4 beneficios con íconos y frasco en pedestal) — estructuras/np-02.json
ad_info.reference_style: Premium product hero: giant 2-line headline, ingredient pill, 4 benefits with circular icons, handwritten phrase, bottle on a stone pedestal with light swirls, dark band with 3 trust seals
ad_info.angle_used: Beneficio principal — curves, naturally (pain: comparing herself to Instagram and feeling flat)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: grey speckled granite #9A9498 for the pedestal and fresh palm green #3E8A4F for the leaves.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium studio still life with glowing light swirls; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo; a real phone-photo inset of the woman's problem.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Aspirational and self-confident, warm studio glow, never clinical.
global_identity.graphic_language: Plum-to-magenta gradient, fuchsia light swirls, white line icons in fuchsia-outlined circles with thin separator lines, a blush ingredient pill, white handwritten script, a dark band with 3 seals divided by thin vertical lines.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look); the handwritten phrase in a brush script.

creative_objective: Position the bottle as the premium natural answer for slim young women who compare themselves online: a huge 'CURVAS AL NATURAL', the three ingredients, four clear benefits and a pedestal hero shot, with a real mirror inset that shows the feeling of being flat and a trust band at the bottom.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the giant headline, 2) the bottle on the pedestal, 3) the mirror inset, 4) the ingredient pill and the 4 benefits, 5) the handwritten phrase, 6) the bottom trust band.
art_direction.composition_style: Left column of text (headline, pill, benefits, script); right column with the photo inset on top and the bottle on its pedestal below, overlapping the inset's lower edge; full-width dark band at the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Left column 5–50% width; benefits evenly spaced with thin white separator lines; bottle centered at 74% width; band 86–100% split in 3 equal cells.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm studio key light from the front-left, a fuchsia rim from behind, glowing fuchsia light swirls orbiting the bottle, a soft shadow of the bottle on the granite pedestal, palm leaves with slight depth of field blur.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 30%: giant 2-line white headline at top-left and a light pill with the star ingredients. Middle 55%: 4 benefits with circular icons at left with thin separators, a handwritten phrase under the list, and the bottle on a stone pedestal at right with glowing light swirls and floating leaves. Bottom 15%: dark band with 3 trust seals with icons. Added by batch rule: a real phone-photo inset of the woman's problem at the top right (about 25% of the canvas), behind the top of the bottle.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium product hero ad. BACKGROUND: smooth radial gradient from dark plum #2B1226 at the edges to deep magenta #B0105E behind the bottle, with thin glowing hot-fuchsia #E6177F light swirls (elliptical light trails with tiny sparkles) orbiting the bottle, and two or three fresh green aguaje palm leaflets #3E8A4F floating at the edges, slightly blurred. TOP-LEFT (3–24% height, 5–50% width): giant 2-line headline, flush left: line 1 'CURVAS' in white Montserrat Black uppercase, enormous; line 2 'AL NATURAL' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase, about half the height of line 1. Under it (25–31%) a rounded pale blush #FBE3EE pill with dark plum #2B1226 Poppins Bold uppercase text. LEFT LIST (34–68% height, 5–48% width): 4 benefit rows, each with a 70 px circle with a 2 px hot-fuchsia outline holding a white thin-line icon (a curved hip silhouette line; a small lightning bolt; a small calendar with two dots; a crossed-out syringe), and to its right 2 lines of white text: first line Poppins Regular uppercase, second line Poppins Bold uppercase; thin white separator lines between rows. LEFT (70–83% height, 5–46% width): a white brush-script handwritten phrase on 2 lines, slightly rotated, with a sweeping underline swoosh. TOP-RIGHT PHOTO INSET (2–56% height, 50–97% width, about 25% of the canvas): a real vertical smartphone photo with a thin 6 px white frame, rounded corners and a soft shadow: a slim Colombian woman around 22, curly dark hair loose, warm brown skin with visible pores and natural shine, black sleeveless bodysuit and beige stretch leggings that hang flat and loose at the hips and back; she stands in side profile in front of a full-length mirror in a small apartment, holding her phone in one hand, the other hand resting on her flat hip, looking at her reflection with an unsure, deflated face; soft morning window light from the right, a clothes rack blurred behind; slight phone grain. RIGHT (40–85% height, centered at 74% width): a round grey speckled granite pedestal #9A9498 with a polished top; standing on it the real product bottle, upright, front-facing, camera slightly below label height, about 40% of the canvas height, overlapping the lower edge of the inset, label perfectly readable, warm studio key light from the front-left and a fuchsia rim from behind, soft shadow on the stone. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh; three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)'. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed, no loose capsules; label reads the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM BAND (86–100%): full-width very dark plum #1A0A17 band divided into 3 equal cells by thin white vertical lines; each cell has a white line icon and 2 lines of white Poppins SemiBold uppercase: left cell a rounded badge with a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a white shield icon holding the registration text ('REGISTRO INVIMA' above the number); center cell a hand-and-box icon with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR'; right cell a small bottle outline icon with '60 CÁPSULAS POR FRASCO'. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written.

mandatory_visual_elements: Plum-to-magenta gradient background with glowing fuchsia light swirls and a few floating palm leaflets
Blush ingredient pill under the headline
Four white line icons inside fuchsia-outlined circles with thin separators
White brush-script phrase with an underline swoosh
Real phone-photo inset at the top right (about 25% of the canvas): slim young woman in a black bodysuit and loose beige leggings, side profile at a full-length mirror, deflated face
The real closed product bottle on a grey granite pedestal, front-facing, label readable
Very dark plum bottom band with 3 seals; the registration one as a badge with a solid fuchsia border
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand
No asterisks, no prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials or 'envío gratis'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
No explicit body shots; the woman stays clothed
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, extra benefits, ratings, testimonials, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. Benefits are worded as support ('acompaña'), no medical or weight claims, no guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
